html.when_on_the_app_asks_the_national: When on, the app asks the National Weather Service for forecasts and alerts at points ahead of you and loads Caltrans road data and camera images. Traffic (California Highway Patrol incidents and Caltrans lane closures) comes as one list for all of I-5 from i5.dominares.org, so that request never says where you are. Live road info sends nothing else (see Privacy, under About).

html.mileposts_follow_californias_exit: Mileposts follow California's exit numbers, which count up from the Mexico border. Every landmark lists its source on the Ahead tab. Road geometry, exits and services come from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Live data: National Weather Service, Caltrans, California Highway Patrol. 3D map: terrain from Mapzen/AWS Terrain Tiles, map from OpenFreeMap and OpenStreetMap contributors; it loads map pictures from those services only while it is open. Photos from Wikimedia Commons, credited on each photo. Elevation: SRTM via OpenTopoData.
